style: Say curiously and warmly, like a friendly school librarian
lines: Hi, I'm Pip! Let's draw something that really happened to you. I'll ask one question at a time.
Now you tell the story. I'll show each part the way you drew it.
Why did you draw it that way? Tap an art word.
When this part is done, tap Next question.
All done! Tap Tell it, and tell us your story.
Tell us about this part. Then tap Next step.
What a story! Thank you for sharing it.
Could not save on this device.
The paper is full. Tap Undo, or start a new drawing.
Pick a tool and a color. Tap Close, then draw on the paper.
Tap a sticker. Drag it on the paper. Use Size to make it bigger or smaller.
Tap a question to add to that part of your picture.
Start a new drawing? Your changes are not saved. Tap Yes, start new, or Keep drawing.
Six drawings are saved. Tap Replace the oldest, or Cancel.
Your changes are not saved. Keep drawing, or open the other drawing.
Pip's day at the pond. Tap Tell it, or tap Draw more to make your own copy.
Look at your whole story. Tap Start over to tell it again, or Draw more to add to it.
This is your copy. Draw on the paper to add your own details.
Where were you? Draw the place.
Who was there with you? Draw them.
What were you doing? Show it.
What was the sky like? Draw it.
What could you hear? Draw the sound with lines.
How did you feel? Add a color that shows it.
What is the most important part? Make it stand out.
Bright colors. They make a picture feel happy and loud.
Dark colors. They can show night, or a quiet feeling.
You made it big. Big things look important.
You made it small. Small things look little, or far away.
You put it in front, near the bottom. Things in front look close.
You put it far back, up high. It looks far away.
Curvy lines. They feel soft, like wind or water.
Zigzag lines. They feel fast, or loud, or bumpy.
Lots of little details. Now we can look closer.
Right in the middle. That is where our eyes go first.
Drag your sticker or use Size to resize it, then tap an art word to say why.
Watch this part. Then tell us about it.
Drag the selected sticker. Use Size to make it bigger or smaller.
